description: A Dart source file defining the AnnotationService class that manages user annotations and reader UI preferences for a Flutter application. It handles storage in SQLite for native platforms and in-memory storage with SharedPreferences fallback for web, offering features such as CRUD operations for annotations and preferences management.

classes.name: AnnotationService
classes.description: Singleton class managing annotations and user preferences for reading experience, with platform-specific storage.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the database for native platforms or prepares preferences; safe to call multiple times.

methods.name: _ensureDb
methods.description: Ensures the SQLite database is available for native platforms.

methods.name: getByChapter
methods.description: Retrieves all annotations for a specified chapter, sorted by creation time.

methods.name: getByChapterSection
methods.description: Retrieves annotations for a chapter and optional section, sorted by start offset and creation time.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Inserts a new annotation into storage, assigning an ID if necessary.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing annotation by ID.

methods.name: clearForChapter
methods.description: Removes all annotations for a given chapter.

methods.name: getFontSize
methods.description: Retrieves the user's preferred font size.

methods.name: setFontSize
methods.description: Sets the user's preferred font size.

methods.name: getShowNotesSidebar
methods.description: Retrieves whether the notes sidebar should be shown.

methods.name: setShowNotesSidebar
methods.description: Sets the visibility of the notes sidebar.

methods.name: debugClearAll
methods.description: Clears all annotations, used for testing.

methods.name: debugClose
methods.description: Closes the database connection, used for testing.
